# Named concepts and tools

A term is counted when the question text says it. A question that asks about a vector index without writing HNSW is not in the HNSW row. A mention in an interview question is not a job requirement, and these are not firm classifier labels — they are string matches against a closed list fixed in [Phase 1](../docs/PHASE1.md).
